name: 1-Channel Optocoupled 5V Relay
description: Like a heavy-duty electric light switch! Uses an electromagnet to safely switch external high-current circuits.
realWorldAnalogy: Like a heavy-duty electric light switch! Uses an electromagnet to safely switch external high-current circuits.

hazards: High voltage switching hazard if connected to mains AC
safety.childSafeAlternative: Use only with low voltage DC (batteries under 12V); NEVER connect to 120V/240V wall outlets

wiringGuidance: Connect VCC (Red) to 5V, GND (Dark Slate) to GND, and IN (Green) to digital pin 7. Use only with low-voltage DC loads (under 12V).
commonMistakes: Attempting to wire 120V/240V mains household voltage (strictly forbidden without adult supervision).
Not accounting for active-LOW relay triggering.

miniExperiment.title: Relay Click Switcher
miniExperiment.circuit: VCC to 5V, GND to GND, IN to Pin 7.
miniExperiment.expectedOutput: The mechanical relay audibly clicks every two seconds and toggles its indicator LED.
